Nach deiner ausdrücklichen Bestätigung l: With your explicit consent, we read your Discogs username, account ID and release data from your collection and wantlist. We also store encrypted OAuth credentials, consent time, import status and visibility settings. We do not import private notes, condition, prices or messages. Available Discogs covers are fetched by our server from approved Discogs image hosts and cached in memory for at most ten minutes. Access requires a fresh import authorized for you. Demo covers are our own fictional illustrations.
Dein persönliches Collection-Profil ents: Your personal collection profile is based on your consent to import (GDPR Article 6(1)(a)). Sign-in and technical provision support your use of the requested service (Article 6(1)(b)). The operator must have these bases reviewed before launch. Cross-user comparisons remain disabled pending clarification with Discogs and then require a separate voluntary opt-in.
Importdaten werden höchstens sechs Stund: Imported data is displayed for at most six hours and removed from the active database on the next request or during the import worker's two-second idle cycle. Tokens and account data remain until account deletion. Import jobs are removed after seven days. The essential session cookie and server-side session allow sign-in for at most seven days. There are no analytics or advertising cookies. To limit sign-in attempts we retain a client identifier hashed with the app key for ten minutes.
. Für Anmeldung und Import kommuniziert: . For sign-in and import, our server communicates with Discogs (Zink Media, LLC, USA). Before public launch, hosting contracts, processor arrangements, server logs, international transfers and backup retention must be reviewed and fully described here.
Du kannst deine gespeicherten Profildate: You can download your stored profile data, withdraw visibility and delete your account and active imports. Also revoke the app in your Discogs settings. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of prior processing. Subject to applicable law, you have rights of access, correction, erasure, restriction and portability, and may complain to a data protection authority. Contact the operator listed above.
Der Release-Match berechnet die Schnittm: The release score divides the overlap of unique releases by the geometric mean of both collection sizes. It describes collection similarity and does not make decisions with legal or similarly significant effects about a person.
